    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        await support.create_support(visitor(), desk.org_id, asked(new_id()))
    assert (await support.get_supports(desk, None, 10)).items == ()
    assert twin.checkouts == {}


async def test_another_reader_reaches_no_support_of_this_one(
    support: SupportManagerImpl, journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl, twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl
) -> None:
    desk, reader, made = await an_open_support(support, journalists)
    other = visitor("other@example.test")
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        await support.get_my_support(other, desk.org_id, made.id)
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        await support.get_my_support(reader, new_id(), made.id)
    replay = asked(made.journalist_id, support_id=made.id)
    with pytest.raises(NotFound):
        await support.create_support(other, desk.org_id, replay)
    assert (await support.get_my_supports(other, None, 10)).items == ()
    assert len(twin.checkouts) == 1


async def test_a_readers_supports_span_desks_and_are_paged(
    support: SupportManagerImpl, journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl
) -> None:
    reader = visitor()
    held = []
    for _ in range(3):
        desk = context(Role.OWNER)
        journalist = await a_journalist(journalists, desk)
        made = await support.create_support(reader, desk.org_id, asked(journalist.id))
        held.append((desk.org_id, made))
    first = await support.get_my_supports(reader, None, 50)
    assert [(r.org_id, r.support) for r in first.items] == held[:2] and first.has_more
    rest = await support.get_my_supports(reader, first.items[-1].support.id, 50)
    assert [(r.org_id, r.support) for r in rest.items] == held[2:] and not rest.has_more


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("cadence", "status"),
    [
        (SupportCadence.ONE_TIME, SupportStatus.PAID),
        (SupportCadence.MONTHLY, SupportStatus.ACTIVE),
        (SupportCadence.ONE_TIME, SupportStatus.FAILED),
        (SupportCadence.ONE_TIME, SupportStatus.EXPIRED),
    ],
)
async def test_a_payment_is_recorded_once(
    support: SupportManagerImpl,
    journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl,
    events: EventStorageMemoryImpl,
    cadence: SupportCadence,
    status: SupportStatus,
) -> None:
    desk, reader, made = await an_open_support(support, journalists, cadence)
    assert made.checkout_id is not None
    assert await support.record_payment(desk, made.id, made.checkout_id, status) is True
    recorded = await support.get_my_support(reader, desk.org_id, made.id)
    assert (recorded.status, recorded.version, recorded.updated_by) == (status, 3, desk.user_id)
    assert (recorded.checkout_id, recorded.identity_id) == (made.checkout_id, made.identity_id)
    assert await support.record_payment(desk, made.id, made.checkout_id, status) is False
    assert await support.get_my_support(reader, desk.org_id, made.id) == recorded
    updates = [
        (e.kind, e.actor_id, dict(e.payload))
        for e in await events.read_after(desk.org_id, 0, 10)
        if e.kind == "support.support.updated"
    ]
    assert updates[-1] == ("support.support.updated", desk.user_id, {"version": 3})
    assert len(updates) == 2, "the copy announced nothing"


async def test_a_settled_support_moves_no_more(

from pathlib import Path

from api_support import build_container

from free_journalism.services.api.app import create_app

SECRET_FIELDS = frozenset({"token", "key", "ticket", "otpauth_uri"})


def test_a_view_that_carries_a_minted_secret_is_named_issued(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    document = create_app(build_container(tmp_path)).openapi()
    schemas = document["components"]["schemas"]
    carrying = sorted(
        name
        for name, schema in schemas.items()
        if name.endswith("View") and SECRET_FIELDS & set(schema.get("properties", {}))
    )
    assert carrying == [
        "IssuedApiKeyView",
        "IssuedLoginView",
        "IssuedOperatorTokenView",
        "IssuedSessionView",
        "IssuedTicketView",
        "IssuedTotpSecretView",
    ]
    assert all(name.startswith("Issued") for name in carrying)
    ticket = document["paths"]["/v1/realtime/tickets"]["post"]["responses"]["201"]
    assert ticket["content"]["application/json"]["schema"] == {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/IssuedTicketView"
    }

from free_journalism.om.reports.types.message import Message, MessageAuthor
from free_journalism.om.reports.types.page import DeliveryPage, MessagePage
from free_journalism.om.reports.types.sent import DeliveryRef, Recipient, SentReport
from free_journalism.om.tenancy import TenancyManagerInterface

BUCKET = Buckets.SEALED_REPORTS
"""Every sealed report lives in its own bucket, under the system scope, no
desk's prefix, by the report's id (ADR 0087)."""

OPENED_KIND = "reports.delivery.opened"
"""The audit entry of a journalist-side open of a sealed report."""


def report_key(report_id: UUID) -> str:
    return str(report_id)


def delivery_id_of(report_id: UUID, recipient: Recipient) -> UUID:
    """The one id a report's copy at a journalist's desk has, however many
    times it is sent: derived from the report's id, the instant that id
    carries, and the desk and journalist it goes to."""
    return derived_id(
        report_id, minted_at(report_id), f"{recipient.org_id}/{recipient.journalist_id}"
    )


class ReportsOptions(Platform):
    max_limit: int = 200
    purge_batch: int = 1000  # rows one purge call deletes at most
    max_recipients: int = MAX_RECIPIENTS
    max_report_bytes: int = MAX_REPORT_BYTES
    max_message_bytes: int = MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES


class ReportsManagerImpl(ReportsManagerInterface):
    def __init__(
        self,
        storage: ReportsStorageInterface,
        journalists: JournalistsManagerInterface,
        events: EventsManagerInterface,
        tenancy: TenancyManagerInterface,
        relay: OutboxRelayInterface,
        buckets: BucketsInterface,
        options: ReportsOptions,
    ) -> None:
        self._storage = storage
        self._journalists = journalists
        self._events = events
        self._tenancy = tenancy
        self._relay = relay
        self._buckets = buckets
        self._options = options

    # The source's side, on the request stage: nobody is known.

    async def send_report(
        self, rctx: RequestContext, report: SentReport
    ) -> tuple[DeliveryRef, ...]:
        # The request stage holds no permission of any desk: what bounds the
        # write is that each delivery lands only at a desk whose journalist
        # the report was sealed for, under an id derived from the report's.
        self._refusal(report)
        for recipient in report.recipients:
            journalist = await self._journalists.get_public_journalist(
                rctx, recipient.org_id, recipient.journalist_id
            )
            if journalist.public_key is None:
                raise ValidationFailed(f"journalist {journalist.id} takes no report yet")
        digest = digest_of(report.ciphertext)
        refs = tuple(
            DeliveryRef(
                org_id=r.org_id,
                journalist_id=r.journalist_id,
                delivery_id=delivery_id_of(report.report_id, r),
            )
            for r in report.recipients
        )
        # A send made again finds what the first one landed. Its ciphertext
        # must be the one already kept, or the report's id names two reports.
        for ref in refs:
            held = await self._storage.read_delivery(ref.org_id, ref.delivery_id)
            if held is not None and held.report_digest != digest:
                raise Conflict(f"report {report.report_id} was sent with another ciphertext")
        await self._keep(rctx, report, digest)
        now = utcnow()
        for recipient, ref in zip(report.recipients, refs, strict=True):
            delivery = Delivery(
                id=ref.delivery_id,
                created_at=now,
                updated_at=now,
                created_by=EMPTY_UUID,
                updated_by=EMPTY_UUID,
                report_id=report.report_id,
                journalist_id=recipient.journalist_id,
                wrapped_key=recipient.wrapped_key,
                report_digest=digest,
                report_size=len(report.ciphertext),
                source_public_key=report.source_public_key,
                follow_up_digest=report.follow_up_digest,
            )
            rows = (visitor_row(rctx, ref.org_id, "reports.delivery.created", delivery.id, {}),)
            if await self._storage.create_delivery(ref.org_id, delivery, rows):
                await self._relay.relay_all(ref.org_id, rows)
            elif await self._storage.read_delivery(ref.org_id, delivery.id) is None:
                raise TenantMismatch(f"delivery {delivery.id} is not in {ref.org_id}")
        return refs

    async def get_thread(
        self,
        rctx: RequestContext,
        org_id: UUID,
        delivery_id: UUID,
        secret: str,
        after: UUID | None,
        limit: int,
    ) -> MessagePage:
        delivery = await self._thread(org_id, delivery_id, secret)
        return await self._page(org_id, delivery.id, after, limit)

    async def send_follow_up(
        self,
        rctx: RequestContext,
        org_id: UUID,
        delivery_id: UUID,
        secret: str,
        message: Message,
    ) -> Message:
        delivery = await self._thread(org_id, delivery_id, secret)
        written = self._message(message, delivery.id, MessageAuthor.SOURCE, EMPTY_UUID)
        row = visitor_row(
            rctx, org_id, "reports.message.created", written.id, {"delivery_id": str(delivery.id)}
        )
        return await self._append(org_id, written, row)

    # The desk's side, on the tenant stage.

    async def get_deliveries(
        self,
        ctx: TenantContext,
        state: DeliveryState | None,
        tag: str | None,
        after: UUID | None,
        limit: int,
    ) -> DeliveryPage:
        ctx.require(Permission.READ)
        limit = max(1, min(limit, self._options.max_limit))
        rows = await self._storage.read_deliveries(ctx.org_id, state, tag, after, limit + 1)
        return DeliveryPage(items=tuple(rows[:limit]), has_more=len(rows) > limit)

    async def get_delivery(self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID) -> Delivery:
        ctx.require(Permission.READ)
        delivery = await self._storage.read_delivery(ctx.org_id, delivery_id)
        if delivery is None:
            raise NotFound(f"delivery {delivery_id} not found")
        return delivery

    async def update_delivery(self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery: Delivery) -> Delivery:
        ctx.require(Permission.WRITE)
        current = await self.get_delivery(ctx, delivery.id)
        changes = delivery.model_dump(
            exclude=set(PROVENANCE_FIELDS) | set(Delivery.MANAGER_OWNED_FIELDS)
        )
        updated = Delivery.model_validate(
            {
                **current.model_dump(),
                **changes,
                "updated_at": utcnow(),
                "updated_by": ctx.user_id,
            }
        )
        rows = (outbox_row(ctx, "reports.delivery.updated", updated.id, {}),)
        await self._storage.write_delivery(ctx.org_id, updated, rows)
        await self._relay.relay_all(ctx.org_id, rows)
        return updated

    async def get_report(self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID) -> bytes:
        ctx.require(Permission.READ)
        delivery = await self.get_delivery(ctx, delivery_id)
        # The entry first: a read that fails after it leaves an open on record
        # that returned nothing, never bytes that left with no entry.
        await self._events.append_event(
            ctx,
            audit_event(
                ctx,
                new_id(),
                OPENED_KIND,
                delivery.id,
                {"report_id": str(delivery.report_id)},  # ids only
            ),
        )
        return await self._buckets.get(
            EMPTY_UUID, BUCKET, report_key(delivery.report_id), deadline=ctx.deadline
        )

    async def create_message(
        self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID, message: Message
    ) -> Message:
        ctx.require(Permission.WRITE)
        delivery = await self.get_delivery(ctx, delivery_id)
        if delivery.source_public_key is None:
            raise ValidationFailed(f"the source of delivery {delivery.id} takes no reply")
        written = self._message(message, delivery.id, MessageAuthor.JOURNALIST, ctx.user_id)
        row = outbox_row(
            ctx, "reports.message.created", written.id, {"delivery_id": str(delivery.id)}
        )
        return await self._append(ctx.org_id, written, row)

    async def get_messages(
        self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID, after: UUID | None, limit: int
    ) -> MessagePage:
        delivery = await self.get_delivery(ctx, delivery_id)
        return await self._page(ctx.org_id, delivery.id, after, limit)

    async def purge_tenant(self, ctx: TenantContext) -> int:
        ctx.require(Permission.WRITE)
        if not await self._tenancy.tenant_expired(ctx):
            return 0
        # The sealed object stays: other desks' deliveries may name it.
        return await self._storage.purge_tenant(ctx.org_id, self._options.purge_batch)

    # Helpers.

    def _refusal(self, report: SentReport) -> None:
        """Everything a send is held to before anything is read or written."""
        recipients = report.recipients
        if not 1 <= len(recipients) <= self._options.max_recipients:
            raise ValidationFailed(
                f"a report goes to 1 to {self._options.max_recipients} journalists"
            )
        if len({(r.org_id, r.journalist_id) for r in recipients}) != len(recipients):
            raise ValidationFailed("a report goes to each journalist once")
        if not report.ciphertext:
            raise ValidationFailed("a report is not empty")
        if len(report.ciphertext) > self._options.max_report_bytes:
            raise ValidationFailed(f"a report is at most {self._options.max_report_bytes} bytes")
        if (report.source_public_key is None) != (report.follow_up_digest is None):
            raise ValidationFailed("a source's public key and follow-up secret come together")
        try:
            minted_at(report.report_id)
            for recipient in recipients:
                decoded(recipient.wrapped_key, "a wrapped key", MAX_WRAPPED_KEY_BYTES)
            if report.source_public_key is not None:
                public_key_bytes(report.source_public_key)
            checked_digest(report.follow_up_digest)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ValidationFailed(str(error)) from None

    async def _keep(self, rctx: RequestContext, report: SentReport, digest: str) -> None:
        """The one ciphertext, under the system scope. A send made again finds
        it kept and writes nothing; another ciphertext under the same id is
        refused, since other desks' deliveries name the one kept."""
        key = report_key(report.report_id)
        if await self._buckets.exists(EMPTY_UUID, BUCKET, key, deadline=rctx.deadline):
            kept = await self._buckets.get(EMPTY_UUID, BUCKET, key, deadline=rctx.deadline)
            if digest_of(kept) != digest:
                raise Conflict(f"report {report.report_id} was sent with another ciphertext")
            return
        await self._buckets.put(
            EMPTY_UUID,
            BUCKET,
            key,
            report.ciphertext,
            "application/octet-stream",
            deadline=rctx.deadline,
        )

    async def _thread(self, org_id: UUID, delivery_id: UUID, secret: str) -> Delivery:
        """The delivery a source's secret reaches. Every refusal is the same
        `NotFound`, so a caller learns nothing of which part was wrong."""
        delivery = await self._storage.read_delivery(org_id, delivery_id)
        if not secret_matches(secret, None if delivery is None else delivery.follow_up_digest):
            raise NotFound(f"thread {delivery_id} not found")
        assert delivery is not None  # a digest matched, so there is a delivery
        return delivery

    def _message(
        self, message: Message, delivery_id: UUID, author: MessageAuthor, author_id: UUID
    ) -> Message:
        """The message as it is written: the caller's id and ciphertext, bounded;
        the thread, the author, and the time are the manager's."""
        try:
            decoded(message.ciphertext, "a message", self._options.max_message_bytes)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ValidationFailed(str(error)) from None
        return Message(
            id=message.id,
            created_at=utcnow(),
            delivery_id=delivery_id,
            author=author,
            author_id=author_id,
            ciphertext=message.ciphertext,
        )

    async def _append(self, org_id: UUID, message: Message, row: OutboxRow) -> Message:
        """The append and its announcement, or, for an id already written, the
        message as stored when it is this one sent again."""
        if await self._storage.append_message(org_id, message, (row,)):
            await self._relay.relay_all(org_id, (row,))
            return message
        existing = await self._storage.read_message(org_id, message.id)
        if existing is None:
            raise TenantMismatch(f"message {message.id} is not in {org_id}")
        same = (existing.delivery_id, existing.author, existing.author_id, existing.ciphertext)
        if same != (message.delivery_id, message.author, message.author_id, message.ciphertext):
            raise Conflict(f"message {message.id} is another message")
        return existing

    async def _page(
        self, org_id: UUID, delivery_id: UUID, after: UUID | None, limit: int
    ) -> MessagePage:
        limit = max(1, min(limit, self._options.max_limit))
        rows = await self._storage.read_messages(org_id, delivery_id, after, limit + 1)
        return MessagePage(items=tuple(rows[:limit]), has_more=len(rows) > limit)

from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Response

from free_journalism.services.api.gateway.auth import Ctx, Identity
from free_journalism.services.api.gateway.idempotency import Idem
from free_journalism.services.api.gateway.resolve import SupportService
from free_journalism.services.api.types.common import LIMIT_DEFAULT
from free_journalism.services.api.types.support import (
    AddSupportRequest,
    ReaderSupportPageView,
    ReaderSupportView,
    SupportPageView,
)

router = APIRouter(tags=["support"])


@router.post(
    "/desks/{org_id}/journalists/{journalist_id}/supports",
    response_model=ReaderSupportView,
    status_code=201,
)
async def create_support(
    identity: Identity,
    support: SupportService,
    org_id: UUID,
    journalist_id: UUID,
    body: AddSupportRequest,
    idem: Idem,
) -> Response:
    """Support the journalist, once or monthly. The answer carries the page
    the reader pays on; what was paid is the provider's word, read back from
    the support once the provider sends the reader back."""
    return await idem.run(
        201,
        lambda attempt: support.create_support(
            identity, org_id, journalist_id, body, attempt.target_id
        ),
    )


@router.get("/desks/{org_id}/supports/{support_id}", response_model=ReaderSupportView)
async def get_my_support(
    identity: Identity, support: SupportService, org_id: UUID, support_id: UUID
) -> ReaderSupportView:
    """One of the signed-in reader's supports, where it stands now."""
    return await support.get_my_support(identity, org_id, support_id)


@router.get("/supports", response_model=ReaderSupportPageView)
async def list_my_supports(
    identity: Identity,
    support: SupportService,
    cursor: str | None = None,
    limit: int = LIMIT_DEFAULT,
) -> ReaderSupportPageView:
    """The signed-in reader's supports across desks, oldest first."""
    return await support.get_my_supports(identity, cursor, limit)


@router.get("/supporters", response_model=SupportPageView)
async def list_supports(
    ctx: Ctx, support: SupportService, cursor: str | None = None, limit: int = LIMIT_DEFAULT
) -> SupportPageView:
    """The desk's supports, oldest first."""

67	def build_tenancy(
68	    storage: TenancyStorageInterface,
69	    relay: OutboxRelayInterface,
70	    cache: CacheInterface,
71	    options: TenancyOptions,
72	    clock: Callable[[], datetime] = utcnow,
73	    *,
74	    identity_provider: IdentityProviderInterface,
75	) -> TenancyManagerInterface:
76	    """The tenancy manager with its delegates, each built here and handed to
77	    it: a caller outside the namespace reaches a delegate through the
78	    manager, and no impl builds another. A delegate that calls a sibling
79	    takes it here, by its interface, and one that needs an operation of the
80	    manager takes that one operation as a callable. `clock` is the one the
81	    second factor's time step is read from."""
82	    sign_in = TenancySignInManagerImpl(
83	        storage, relay, options, clock, identity_provider=identity_provider
84	    )
85	    # The account's deletion writes a row under each place its person holds,
86	    # and a stage comes only from the manager's transition. The manager holds
87	    # this delegate, so that one edge is bound at call time.
88	    org = TenancyOrgManagerImpl(
89	        storage,
90	        relay,
91	        options,
92	        identity_provider=identity_provider,
93	        service_context=lambda rctx, org_id, user_id: tenancy.service_context(
94	            rctx, org_id, user_id
95	        ),
96	    )
97	    members = TenancyMembersManagerImpl(
98	        storage, relay, options, org=org, identity_provider=identity_provider
99	    )
100	    credentials = TenancyCredentialsManagerImpl(storage, relay, options)
101	    tenancy = TenancyManagerImpl(
102	        storage,
103	        relay,
104	        cache,
105	        options,
106	        sign_in=sign_in,
107	        org=org,
108	        members=members,
109	        credentials=credentials,
110	    )
111	    return tenancy
112	
113	
114	def build_managers(
115	    storage: StorageInterface,
116	    infra: InfraInterface,
117	    tenancy_options: TenancyOptions | None = None,
118	    operator_options: TenancyOperatorOptions | None = None,
119	    integrations: IntegrationsInterface | None = None,
120	    *,
121	    media_options: MediaOptions | None = None,
122	    idempotency_options: IdempotencyOptions | None = None,
123	    events_options: EventsOptions | None = None,
124	    work_options: WorkOptions | None = None,
125	    orchestrations_options: OrchestrationsOptions | None = None,
126	    journalists_options: JournalistsOptions | None = None,
127	    community_options: CommunityOptions | None = None,
128	    support_options: SupportOptions | None = None,
129	) -> Managers:
130	    """`integrations` is the root of the hosted services the managers front:
131	    the identity provider, which the tenancy manager signs people in and
132	    invites them through, and the payments provider, which the support
133	    manager opens a reader's checkout through. None is a process that signs
134	    nobody in and takes no money, and every call that would reach a provider
135	    is refused as unavailable.
136	
137	    The options after `integrations` are what the process that sweeps sets
138	    on the managers it purges through: each one's retention and batch. None
139	    keeps that manager's defaults."""
140	    # The relay every core-role manager hands its outbox rows to. It reaches
141	    # the work manager through the root below, because a row of kind
142	    # `work.<kind>` is enqueued there: the work manager needs the tenancy
143	    # manager, which needs this relay, so that one edge is bound at call time
144	    # and the graph the root hands back is still whole.
145	    outbox = OutboxRelayImpl(
146	        storage.get_outbox_storage(),
147	        storage.get_event_storage(),
148	        infra.get_topics(),
149	        lambda: managers.work,
150	    )
151	    tenancy = build_tenancy(
152	        storage.get_tenancy_storage(),
153	        outbox,
154	        infra.get_cache(CacheScope.REALTIME_TICKET),
155	        tenancy_options or TenancyOptions(),
156	        identity_provider=(
157	            IdentityProviderAbsentImpl()
158	            if integrations is None
159	            else integrations.get_identity_provider()
160	        ),
161	    )
162	    events = EventsManagerImpl(
163	        storage.get_event_storage(), tenancy, events_options or EventsOptions()
164	    )
165	    work = WorkManagerImpl(
166	        storage.get_work_storage(),
167	        tenancy,
168	        events,
169	        infra.get_topics(),
170	        work_options or WorkOptions(),
171	    )
172	    media = MediaManagerImpl(
173	        storage.get_media_storage(),
174	        infra.get_buckets(),
175	        tenancy,
176	        outbox,
177	        media_options or MediaOptions(),
178	    )
179	    orchestrations = OrchestrationsManagerImpl(
180	        storage.get_orchestrations_storage(),
181	        tenancy,
182	        outbox,
183	        orchestrations_options or OrchestrationsOptions(),
184	    )
185	    journalists = JournalistsManagerImpl(
186	        storage.get_journalist_storage(),
187	        tenancy,
188	        outbox,
189	        journalists_options or JournalistsOptions(),
190	    )
191	    community = CommunityManagerImpl(
192	        storage.get_community_storage(),
193	        journalists,
194	        tenancy,
195	        outbox,
196	        community_options or CommunityOptions(),
197	    )
198	    support = SupportManagerImpl(
199	        storage.get_support_storage(),
200	        journalists,
201	        tenancy,
202	        outbox,
203	        (
204	            PaymentsProviderAbsentImpl()
205	            if integrations is None
206	            else integrations.get_payments_provider()
207	        ),
208	        # None is a process that opens no checkout, so sends no one back.
209	        support_options or SupportOptions(checkout_return_url=""),
210	    )
211	    idempotency = IdempotencyManagerImpl(
212	        storage.get_idempotency_storage(), idempotency_options or IdempotencyOptions()
213	    )
214	    tenancy_operator = TenancyOperatorManagerImpl(
215	        storage.get_tenancy_storage(),
216	        storage.get_event_storage(),
217	        outbox,
218	        operator_options or TenancyOperatorOptions(),
219	    )
220	    managers = Managers(
221	        tenancy=tenancy,
222	        tenancy_operator=tenancy_operator,
223	        work=work,
224	        work_operator=WorkOperatorManagerImpl(
225	            storage.get_work_storage(),
226	            storage.get_tenancy_storage(),
227	            storage.get_event_storage(),
228	            infra.get_topics(),
229	        ),
230	        media=media,
231	        idempotency=idempotency,
232	        events=events,
233	        outbox=outbox,
234	        orchestrations=orchestrations,
235	        journalists=journalists,
236	        community=community,
237	        support=support,
238	    )
239	    return managers

def module_blocks(terraform: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Each `module "<name>" { ... }` block of a Terraform file, by name, read
    by matching braces."""
    blocks: dict[str, str] = {}
    for match in re.finditer(r'^module "([a-z_]+)" \{', terraform, flags=re.MULTILINE):
        depth, end = 0, match.end() - 1
        for end in range(match.end() - 1, len(terraform)):
            depth += {"{": 1, "}": -1}.get(terraform[end], 0)
            if depth == 0:
                break
        blocks[match.group(1)] = terraform[match.start() : end + 1]
    return blocks


def test_every_task_of_the_api_image_boots_the_api_sign_in_settings() -> None:
    """The service and the one-off tasks that run the API's image (migrate,
    grant) all boot `ApiSettings`, and a deployed environment refuses its
    sign-in settings left at their local defaults. So each of them is given
    the one shared set, not the service alone: a task without it fails at
    boot, and a migrate task that fails stops the release."""
    environment = repository_root() / "deployment" / "terraform" / "modules" / "environment"
    blocks = module_blocks((environment / "main.tf").read_text())
    api_image = {name: block for name, block in blocks.items() if "var.api_image" in block}
    assert {"api", "migrate", "grant"} <= set(api_image)
    missing = sorted(
        name for name, block in api_image.items() if "local.api_sign_in_environment" not in block
    )
    assert not missing, f"tasks of the API image without the sign-in settings: {missing}"

from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit
from uuid import uuid4

import httpx
import pytest
from api_support import build_container, sign_in_personal
from pydantic import ValidationError

from free_journalism.integrations.exceptions import ProviderUnavailable
from free_journalism.integrations.identity.twin import IdentityProviderTwinImpl
from free_journalism.integrations.impl.configured import IntegrationsOverImpl
from free_journalism.integrations.payments import Cadence, Checkout, CheckoutRequest
from free_journalism.integrations.payments.twin import PaymentsProviderTwinImpl
from free_journalism.services.api.container import AppContainer
from free_journalism.services.api.settings import ApiSettings

BODY = {"amount": 1500, "currency": "eur", "cadence": "monthly"}


@pytest.fixture
def twin() -> PaymentsProviderTwinImpl:
    return PaymentsProviderTwinImpl()


@pytest.fixture
def container(tmp_path: Path, twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl) -> AppContainer:
    return build_container(
        tmp_path, integrations=IntegrationsOverImpl(IdentityProviderTwinImpl(), twin)
    )


async def a_desk(client: httpx.AsyncClient, email: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str, str]:
    """A journalist's own desk with one journalist: its headers, its id, and
    the journalist's id."""
    desk = await sign_in_personal(client, email)
    org_id = (await client.get("/v1/orgs/current", headers=desk)).json()["id"]
    added = await client.post(
        "/v1/journalists",
        headers={**desk, "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid4())},
        json={"display_name": "Ada Reporter"},
    )
    assert added.status_code == 201, added.text
    return desk, org_id, added.json()["id"]


def keyed(headers: dict[str, str], key: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {**headers, "Idempotency-Key": key or str(uuid4())}


async def test_a_reader_supports_a_journalist_of_another_desk(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl
) -> None:
    desk, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    reader = await sign_in_personal(client, "rae@example.test")
    path = f"/v1/desks/{org_id}/journalists/{journalist_id}/supports"
    key = str(uuid4())
    made = await client.post(path, headers=keyed(reader, key), json=BODY)
    assert made.status_code == 201, made.text
    support = made.json()
    [(checkout_id, request)] = twin.checkouts.items()
    assert support["checkout_url"] and support["checkout_url"].endswith(checkout_id)
    assert {k: support[k] for k in ("org_id", "journalist_id", "status", "version")} == {
        "org_id": org_id,
        "journalist_id": journalist_id,
        "status": "open",
        "version": 2,
    }
    assert (request.amount, request.currency, request.cadence) == (1500, "eur", Cadence.MONTHLY)
    assert request.application_fee == 75, "the platform's 5%"
    back = urlsplit(request.success_url)
    assert f"{back.scheme}://{back.netloc}{back.path}" == "http://localhost:55173/supports"
    assert parse_qs(back.query)["support"] == [support["id"]]
    again = await client.post(path, headers=keyed(reader, key), json=BODY)
    assert again.status_code == 201 and again.json() == support
    assert len(twin.checkouts) == 1, "a retry opens no second checkout"
    read = await client.get(f"/v1/desks/{org_id}/supports/{support['id']}", headers=reader)
    assert read.status_code == 200 and read.json() == support
    mine = await client.get("/v1/supports", headers=reader)
    assert mine.status_code == 200 and mine.json() == {"items": [support], "next_cursor": None}
    supporters = await client.get("/v1/supporters", headers=desk)
    assert supporters.status_code == 200, supporters.text
    assert supporters.json()["items"] == [
        {
            k: support[k]
            for k in (
                "id",
                "journalist_id",
                "amount",
                "currency",
                "cadence",
                "status",
                "created_at",
                "updated_at",
                "version",
            )
        }
    ], "the desk sees that it is supported, never by whom nor the reader's checkout"
    assert (await client.get("/v1/supporters", headers=reader)).json()["items"] == []


async def test_a_provider_that_is_down_answers_503_and_a_retry_opens_the_checkout(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    reader = await sign_in_personal(client, "rae@example.test")
    path = f"/v1/desks/{org_id}/journalists/{journalist_id}/supports"
    key = str(uuid4())

    async def down(_: CheckoutRequest, *, deadline: object = None) -> Checkout:
        raise ProviderUnavailable("the payments provider did not answer")

    monkeypatch.setattr(twin, "open_checkout", down)
    refused = await client.post(path, headers=keyed(reader, key), json=BODY)
    assert refused.status_code == 503, refused.text
    monkeypatch.undo()
    opened = await client.post(path, headers=keyed(reader, key), json=BODY)
    assert opened.status_code == 201, opened.text
    assert opened.json()["status"] == "open" and len(twin.checkouts) == 1
    mine = (await client.get("/v1/supports", headers=reader)).json()["items"]
    assert [s["id"] for s in mine] == [opened.json()["id"]], "one support, opened on retry"


async def test_another_desk_or_reader_reaches_no_support(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    _, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    other_desk, other_org, _ = await a_desk(client, "bea@example.test")
    reader = await sign_in_personal(client, "rae@example.test")
    made = await client.post(
        f"/v1/desks/{org_id}/journalists/{journalist_id}/supports", headers=keyed(reader), json=BODY
    )
    support_id = made.json()["id"]
    elsewhere = await client.get(f"/v1/desks/{other_org}/supports/{support_id}", headers=reader)
    assert elsewhere.status_code == 404, "another desk naming this desk's support"
    stranger = await sign_in_personal(client, "sam@example.test")
    theirs = await client.get(f"/v1/desks/{org_id}/supports/{support_id}", headers=stranger)
    assert theirs.status_code == 404, "another reader's support"
    assert (await client.get("/v1/supports", headers=stranger)).json()["items"] == []
    assert (await client.get("/v1/supporters", headers=other_desk)).json()["items"] == []
    wrong_desk = await client.post(
        f"/v1/desks/{other_org}/journalists/{journalist_id}/supports",
        headers=keyed(reader),
        json=BODY,
    )
    assert wrong_desk.status_code == 404, "a journalist the desk does not hold"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "body",
    [
        {**BODY, "amount": 50},
        {**BODY, "amount": 1_000_001},
        {**BODY, "currency": "EUR"},
        {**BODY, "cadence": "weekly"},
    ],
)
async def test_a_support_out_of_bounds_is_refused(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl, body: dict[str, object]
) -> None:
    _, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    reader = await sign_in_personal(client, "rae@example.test")
    refused = await client.post(

The background process of Free Journalism. Every replica runs three things side by
side, started in `main.py`.

- **The work loop** (`loop.py`) claims items from the work queue on its
  lane and runs each under the context the claim built. It renews each
  lease, and completes, fails, parks, or refuses the item. The handlers are
  in `handler.py`, `orchestrations.py`, and `accounts.py`.
- **The delivery consumer** (`deliveries.py`) long-polls `Queues.WEBHOOKS`,
  where the API queues each provider's verified delivery, and applies it
  once in the org it names. A message that can never apply is dropped; any
  other failure comes back.
- **The sweep** (`loop.py`) runs on a timer, within a budget. It requeues
  expired leases, relays the outbox, purges every row past its retention
  (`settings.py`), counts the platform's size, and logs the queue's gauges.

`serve` runs the three; `health` asks the running process's `/healthz`.

## Adding a work kind

Add the kind, its payload, and the permission that asks for it in
`free_journalism.om.work`. Write a handler that names the permissions it calls with
(`REQUIRES`), and add it to `handlers` in `build_loop`; a test holds the
two to each other. A long-running kind is an `OrchestrationKind` whose step
is mapped in `build_loop`.

## Adding a delivery provider

Implement `DeliveryProviderInterface`: read the delivery, name its org, and
apply it under an id derived from its key, so a copy changes nothing. Add it
to `providers` in `build_consumer`, under the name the API queues it with.

class PaymentDeliveriesImpl(DeliveryProviderInterface[PaymentDelivery]):
    def __init__(self, support: SupportManagerInterface) -> None:
        self._support = support

    def read(self, delivery: object) -> PaymentDelivery:
        return PaymentDelivery.model_validate(delivery)

    async def org_of(self, rctx: RequestContext, delivery: PaymentDelivery) -> UUID | None:
        # The checkout carries the desk's org id in its metadata, and every
        # delivery about it names it again.
        return delivery.org_id

    async def apply(self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery: PaymentDelivery) -> bool:
        if delivery.reference is None or delivery.checkout_id is None or delivery.outcome is None:
            # An event the product does not act on, or one about a checkout
            # Free Journalism did not open: nothing to record.
            return False

            return await self._support.record_payment(
                ctx, delivery.reference, delivery.checkout_id, RECORDED[delivery.outcome]
            )
        except NotFound:
            # The desk holds no such support: purged with its desk, or never
            # this platform's. No receive would apply it.
            log.warning(
                "payments delivery %s names support %s, which org %s does not hold",
                delivery.event_id,
                delivery.reference,

@pytest.fixture
def twin() -> PaymentsProviderTwinImpl:
    return PaymentsProviderTwinImpl()


def consumer_of(container: WorkerContainer) -> DeliveryConsumer:
    """The worker's own consumer, with a long poll that answers at once."""
    built = build_consumer(container)
    built._options = DeliveryOptions(  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        worker_id="maintenance-test", wait=timedelta(0)
    )
    return built


def reader() -> IdentityContext:
    return IdentityContext(
        request_id=new_id(),
        app=AppContext(type=AppType.PORTAL, version="portal@test"),
        identity_id=new_id(),
        email="rae@example.test",
        credential_kind=CredentialKind.SESSION_TOKEN,
        credential_id=new_id(),
    )


async def an_open_support(
    container: WorkerContainer,
    twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl,
    ctx: TenantContext,
    cadence: SupportCadence = SupportCadence.ONE_TIME,
) -> Support:
    """A reader's support of the desk's journalist, opened as the API opens
    it: over the same storage, with the checkout the twin opened."""
    managers = container.managers
    now = utcnow()
    journalist = await managers.journalists.create_journalist(
        ctx,
        Journalist(
            id=new_id(),
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            created_by=ctx.user_id,
            updated_by=ctx.user_id,
            display_name="Ada Reporter",
        ),
    )
    api_side = SupportManagerImpl(
        container.storage.get_support_storage(),
        managers.journalists,
        managers.tenancy,
        managers.outbox,
        twin,
        SupportOptions(checkout_return_url="http://localhost:55173/supports"),
    )
    asked = Support(
        id=new_id(),
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        created_by=EMPTY_UUID,
        updated_by=EMPTY_UUID,
        version=1,
        journalist_id=journalist.id,
        identity_id=EMPTY_UUID,
        amount=1500,
        currency="eur",
        cadence=cadence,
    )
    return await api_side.create_support(reader(), ctx.org_id, asked)


def delivered(twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl, signed: tuple[bytes, str]) -> PaymentDelivery:
    """The delivery as the API verifies it."""
    return twin.verify_delivery(*signed)


def body_of(delivery: PaymentDelivery) -> bytes:
    """The message the API queues for a verified delivery."""
    return json.dumps(
        {
            "idempotency_key": str(delivery.key),
            "provider": "payments",
            "delivery": delivery.model_dump(mode="json"),
        }
    ).encode()


async def queued(container: WorkerContainer, body: bytes) -> QueueMessage:
    queues = container.infra.get_queues()
    await queues.send(Queues.WEBHOOKS, body)
    [message] = await queues.receive(Queues.WEBHOOKS, 1, timedelta(0), timedelta(seconds=30))
    return message


async def stored(container: WorkerContainer, ctx: TenantContext, support: Support) -> Support:
    found = await container.storage.get_support_storage().read_support(ctx.org_id, support.id)
    assert found is not None
    return found


async def depth(container: WorkerContainer) -> tuple[int, int]:
    found = await container.infra.get_queues().depth(Queues.WEBHOOKS)
    return found.visible, found.in_flight


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("cadence", "status"),
    [(SupportCadence.ONE_TIME, SupportStatus.PAID), (SupportCadence.MONTHLY, SupportStatus.ACTIVE)],
)
async def test_a_paid_checkout_is_recorded_once_when_the_queue_hands_it_over_twice(
    tmp_path: Path,
    twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl,
    cadence: SupportCadence,
    status: SupportStatus,
) -> None:
    container = build_container(tmp_path)
    ctx = await sign_in(container)
    support = await an_open_support(container, twin, ctx, cadence)
    assert support.checkout_id is not None
    delivery = delivered(twin, twin.complete(support.checkout_id))
    consumer = consumer_of(container)
    assert await consumer.handle(await queued(container, body_of(delivery))) == "applied"
    assert await consumer.handle(await queued(container, body_of(delivery))) == "duplicate"
    paid = await stored(container, ctx, support)
    assert (paid.status, paid.version) == (status, support.version + 1)
    assert await depth(container) == (0, 0), "both copies are deleted"


async def test_an_expired_checkout_is_recorded_and_a_later_payment_changes_nothing(
    tmp_path: Path, twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl
) -> None:
    container = build_container(tmp_path)
    ctx = await sign_in(container)
    support = await an_open_support(container, twin, ctx)
    assert support.checkout_id is not None
    consumer = consumer_of(container)
    expired = delivered(twin, twin.expire(support.checkout_id))
    assert await consumer.handle(await queued(container, body_of(expired))) == "applied"
    paid = delivered(twin, twin.complete(support.checkout_id))
    assert await consumer.handle(await queued(container, body_of(paid))) == "duplicate"
    assert (await stored(container, ctx, support)).status is SupportStatus.EXPIRED


async def test_a_delivery_that_records_nothing_is_deleted(
    tmp_path: Path, twin: PaymentsProviderTwinImpl
) -> None:
    """An event the product does not act on, and one about a support the
    desk does not hold, record nothing and never will; one that names no
    desk is dropped. Each is deleted."""
    container = build_container(tmp_path)
    ctx = await sign_in(container)
    support = await an_open_support(container, twin, ctx)
    assert support.checkout_id is not None
    consumer = consumer_of(container)
    other_event = delivered(twin, twin.signed_event("checkout.session.updated", support.checkout_id))
    assert other_event.outcome is None
    unpaid = delivered(twin, twin.complete(support.checkout_id))
    unknown = unpaid.model_copy(update={"key": new_id(), "reference": new_id()})
    unowned = unpaid.model_copy(update={"key": new_id(), "org_id": None})
    cases = [(other_event, "duplicate"), (unknown, "duplicate"), (unowned, "unowned")]
    for delivery, outcome in cases:
        assert await consumer.handle(await queued(container, body_of(delivery))) == outcome
    assert await stored(container, ctx, support) == support
    assert await depth(container) == (0, 0)
    assert COMPLETED == unpaid.event_type

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfZxCnY95R7qnnifui6Ff","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XjyxsCRdzw8fJnPQz61APE","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/var/tmp/swe-benchmark/20260930-083846-create-full-system-4bd30619/workspace/0/free_journalism/om/src/free_journalism/om/support/README.md","content":"# Support

The money readers give a desk's journalists, once or every month. This is
one of the kinds of thing [Free Journalism is made of](../../../../README.md).

## What it holds

- **Support**: one reader's support of one journalist of a desk: the
  amount, in the currency's smallest unit (cents), the currency, whether
  it is given once or monthly, and where it stands. It belongs to the
  desk, and names the reader by their sign-in, never as a person of the
  desk, since a reader is not one. It keeps the payment page the reader
  was sent to, and never a card number: the card is typed on Stripe's own
  page.
- **Status**: `pending` while the payment page is being opened, `open`
  while it waits for the reader to pay, then `paid` for a one-time
  support, `active` for a monthly one that is paid and running, `failed`
  when the payment did not go through after the reader left the page, or
  `expired` when the page lapsed unpaid. Paid, active, failed, and expired
  are settled: in the first release nothing moves a support after that.

What support will also hold, as the product grows: receipts, the
cancelling of a monthly support, refunds, and the desk's payouts account.

## What can happen

- **Support a journalist.** A signed-in reader chooses an amount between
  one and ten thousand, a currency, and once or monthly. The support is
  made pending, the payment page is opened at Stripe with the platform's
  fee set apart, and the reader is sent to it. Sending the same request
  twice makes one support and opens one page. When Stripe cannot be
  reached, the reader is told to try again, and the support stays pending
  until they do.
- **Pay.** The reader pays on Stripe's page and is sent back. Only what
  Stripe then tells the platform, over its own signed channel, marks the
  support paid, active, failed, or expired; the reader's browser coming
  back says nothing.
- **Read one's own.** A reader reads one of their supports again once
  Stripe sends them back, and lists all of theirs across desks, oldest
  first, a page at a time.
- **List the desk's supporters.** A viewer, a member, an admin, or the
  owner of the desk lists the desk's supports, oldest first, a page at a
  time.
- **Sweep.** When a desk is deleted, its supports go with it once the
  desk's retention has passed.

## The rules

- **A support is its desk's.** Another desk's support, and another
  reader's, are answered as ones that never existed.
- **The desk sees that it is supported, never by whom.** What the desk
  lists carries the amount, the cadence, and the status, and never the
  reader or their payment page.
- **Stripe's word is final on money.** A status changes only on what
  Stripe delivered, once, and a copy of the same news changes nothing.
  News about another payment page than the support's changes nothing.
- **The platform's fee is set apart.** The fee is a share of the amount,
  5% unless the platform sets another, taken apart from Stripe's own fee.
- **Changes carry ids.** What the platform announces about a support
  names the support and its version, never the reader or the amount, and
  a change a reader makes names no one.

async def a_journalist(
    journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl, ctx: TenantContext, key: str | None = JOURNALIST_KEY
) -> Journalist:
    now = utcnow()
    return await journalists.create_journalist(
        ctx,
        Journalist(
            id=new_id(),
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            created_by=ctx.user_id,
            updated_by=ctx.user_id,
            display_name="Ada Reporter",
            public_key=key,
        ),
    )


def a_report(
    *recipients: tuple[TenantContext, Journalist],
    ciphertext: bytes = SEALED,
    replies: bool = True,
    report_id: UUID | None = None,
) -> SentReport:
    return SentReport(
        report_id=report_id or new_id(),
        ciphertext=ciphertext,
        recipients=tuple(
            Recipient(org_id=desk.org_id, journalist_id=j.id, wrapped_key=wrapped(n))
            for n, (desk, j) in enumerate(recipients)
        ),
        source_public_key=SOURCE_KEY if replies else None,
        follow_up_digest=hashlib.sha256(SECRET.encode()).hexdigest() if replies else None,
    )


def a_message(text: str = "hello", message_id: UUID | None = None) -> Message:
    """What a caller hands the manager: its id and ciphertext; the rest is
    the manager's, whatever the caller put there."""
    return Message(
        id=message_id or new_id(),
        created_at=utcnow(),
        delivery_id=new_id(),
        author=MessageAuthor.JOURNALIST,
        author_id=new_id(),
        ciphertext=sealed_text(text),
    )


async def sent_to_one(
    reports: ReportsManagerImpl, journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl, *, replies: bool = True
) -> tuple[TenantContext, UUID]:
    desk = context(Role.OWNER)
    journalist = await a_journalist(journalists, desk)
    (ref,) = await reports.send_report(request(), a_report((desk, journalist), replies=replies))
    return desk, ref.delivery_id


async def test_a_report_sent_to_two_desks_is_kept_once_with_a_key_each(
    reports: ReportsManagerImpl,
    journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl,
    infra: InfraLocalImpl,
    events: EventStorageMemoryImpl,
) -> None:
    desk_a, desk_b = context(Role.OWNER), context(Role.OWNER)
    ada, bea = await a_journalist(journalists, desk_a), await a_journalist(journalists, desk_b)
    report = a_report((desk_a, ada), (desk_b, bea))
    refs = await reports.send_report(request(), report)
    assert [(r.org_id, r.journalist_id) for r in refs] == [
        (desk_a.org_id, ada.id),
        (desk_b.org_id, bea.id),
    ]
    buckets = infra.get_buckets()
    assert await buckets.get(EMPTY_UUID, Buckets.SEALED_REPORTS, str(report.report_id)) == SEALED
    assert await buckets.list(EMPTY_UUID, Buckets.SEALED_REPORTS, "", 10) == [
        str(report.report_id)
    ], "one object, whatever the number of desks"
    for desk, ref, n in ((desk_a, refs[0], 0), (desk_b, refs[1], 1)):
        delivery = await reports.get_delivery(desk, ref.delivery_id)
        assert delivery.wrapped_key == wrapped(n)
        assert delivery.report_id == report.report_id
        assert delivery.report_digest == hashlib.sha256(SEALED).hexdigest()
        assert delivery.report_size == len(SEALED)
        assert (delivery.state, delivery.tags) == (DeliveryState.NEW, ())
        assert delivery.created_by == EMPTY_UUID, "a source is nobody the platform knows"
        announced = [
            e for e in await events.read_after(desk.org_id, 0, 10) if e.kind.startswith("reports")
        ]
        assert [(e.kind, e.target_id, e.actor_id, dict(e.payload)) for e in announced] == [
            ("reports.delivery.created", ref.delivery_id, EMPTY_UUID, {})
        ]
    assert refs[0].delivery_id != refs[1].delivery_id


async def test_a_send_made_again_lands_nothing_new(
    reports: ReportsManagerImpl, journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl
) -> None:
    desk_a, desk_b = context(Role.OWNER), context(Role.OWNER)
    ada, bea = await a_journalist(journalists, desk_a), await a_journalist(journalists, desk_b)
    report = a_report((desk_a, ada), (desk_b, bea))
    # A send that reached one desk and failed before the other is made again
    # whole: the first desk answers the row it holds, the second gets its own.
    partial = report.model_copy(update={"recipients": report.recipients[:1]})
    (first,) = await reports.send_report(request(), partial)
    refs = await reports.send_report(request(), report)
    assert refs[0] == first
    assert await reports.send_report(request(), report) == refs
    for desk in (desk_a, desk_b):
        assert len((await reports.get_deliveries(desk, None, None, None, 10)).items) == 1


async def test_a_send_again_with_another_ciphertext_is_refused(
    reports: ReportsManagerImpl, journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl, infra: InfraLocalImpl
) -> None:
    desk_a, desk_b = context(Role.OWNER), context(Role.OWNER)
    ada, bea = await a_journalist(journalists, desk_a), await a_journalist(journalists, desk_b)
    report = a_report((desk_a, ada))
    await reports.send_report(request(), report)
    with pytest.raises(Conflict):
        await reports.send_report(request(), report.model_copy(update={"ciphertext": b"other"}))
    # Another desk, which the first send never reached, is refused as well:
    # the report's id already names a ciphertext.
    elsewhere = a_report((desk_b, bea), ciphertext=b"other", report_id=report.report_id)
    with pytest.raises(Conflict):
        await reports.send_report(request(), elsewhere)
    assert (await reports.get_deliveries(desk_b, None, None, None, 10)).items == ()
    kept = await infra.get_buckets().get(EMPTY_UUID, Buckets.SEALED_REPORTS, str(report.report_id))

async def test_the_journalist_replies_and_the_source_reads_the_thread(
    reports: ReportsManagerImpl, journalists: JournalistsManagerImpl, events: EventStorageMemoryImpl
) -> None:

    sent = a_message("hello, can you say more?")

    assert (reply.id, reply.delivery_id, reply.author, reply.author_id) == (
        sent.id,
        delivery_id,
        MessageAuthor.JOURNALIST,
        desk.user_id,
    )

    follow_up = await reports.send_follow_up(
        request(), desk.org_id, delivery_id, SECRET, a_message("yes: the pipes")

    assert (await reports.get_messages(desk, delivery_id, None, 10)).items == (reply, follow_up)
    announced = [
        (e.kind, e.target_id, e.actor_id, dict(e.payload))
        for e in await events.read_after(desk.org_id, 0, 20)
        if e.kind == "reports.message.created"
    ]
    assert announced == [

"""The follow-up secret a source's device presents: random text of its own
making, long enough that it cannot be guessed; the platform keeps only its

class RecipientRequest(RequestBody):
    """One journalist the report is sealed for, at their desk, with the
    report's key wrapped to their public key, in standard base64."""

    org_id: UUID
    journalist_id: UUID

class SendReportRequest(RequestBody):

    report, in standard base64, at most 5 MiB of it before encoding, and the
    journalists it goes to, each with their own wrapped key. A source who
    wants replies sends the public key a reply is sealed to (X25519, standard
    base64) and the SHA-256, in lower-case hex, of the follow-up secret their
    device keeps; the two come together or not at all."""

    ciphertext: str = Field(min_length=4, max_length=base64_length(MAX_REPORT_BYTES))
    recipients: list[RecipientRequest] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_RECIPIENTS)
    source_public_key: str | None = Field(

import binascii
from uuid import UUID

from free_journalism.om.base import EMPTY_UUID, utcnow
from free_journalism.om.context import RequestContext, TenantContext
from free_journalism.om.exceptions import ValidationFailed
from free_journalism.om.reports import ReportsManagerInterface
from free_journalism.om.reports.types.delivery import Delivery, DeliveryState
from free_journalism.om.reports.types.message import Message, MessageAuthor
from free_journalism.om.reports.types.page import MessagePage
from free_journalism.om.reports.types.sent import Recipient, SentReport
from free_journalism.services.api.services.impl.tenancy import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from free_journalism.services.api.services.reports import ReportsServiceInterface
from free_journalism.services.api.types.common import clamp_limit
from free_journalism.services.api.types.reports import (
    AddMessageRequest,
    DeliveryPageView,
    DeliveryRefView,
    DeliveryView,
    MessagePageView,
    MessageView,
    SealedReportResponse,
    SendReportRequest,
    SentReportView,
    UpdateDeliveryRequest,
)


def delivery_view(delivery: Delivery) -> DeliveryView:
    return DeliveryView(
        id=delivery.id,
        report_id=delivery.report_id,
        journalist_id=delivery.journalist_id,
        wrapped_key=delivery.wrapped_key,
        report_digest=delivery.report_digest,
        report_size=delivery.report_size,
        source_public_key=delivery.source_public_key,
        has_thread=delivery.follow_up_digest is not None,
        state=delivery.state,
        tags=list(delivery.tags),
        created_at=delivery.created_at,
        updated_at=delivery.updated_at,
    )


def message_page_view(listed: str, page: MessagePage) -> MessagePageView:
    return MessagePageView(
        items=[MessageView.model_validate(m) for m in page.items],
        next_cursor=encode_cursor(listed, page.items[-1].id) if page.has_more else None,
    )


def a_message(message_id: UUID, delivery_id: UUID, body: AddMessageRequest) -> Message:
    """The message as the caller sends it: its id and ciphertext. The thread,
    the author, and the time are the manager's, which it sets whatever this
    carries."""
    return Message(
        id=message_id,
        created_at=utcnow(),
        delivery_id=delivery_id,
        author=MessageAuthor.SOURCE,
        author_id=EMPTY_UUID,
        ciphertext=body.ciphertext,
    )


class ReportsServiceImpl(ReportsServiceInterface):
    def __init__(self, reports: ReportsManagerInterface) -> None:
        self._reports = reports

    async def send_report(
        self, rctx: RequestContext, report_id: UUID, body: SendReportRequest
    ) -> SentReportView:
        try:
            ciphertext = base64.b64decode(body.ciphertext, validate=True)
        except binascii.Error:
            raise ValidationFailed("the ciphertext is standard base64") from None
        report = SentReport(
            report_id=report_id,
            ciphertext=ciphertext,
            recipients=tuple(
                Recipient(org_id=r.org_id, journalist_id=r.journalist_id, wrapped_key=r.wrapped_key)
                for r in body.recipients
            ),
            source_public_key=body.source_public_key,
            follow_up_digest=body.follow_up_digest,
        )
        refs = await self._reports.send_report(rctx, report)
        return SentReportView(
            report_id=report_id,
            deliveries=[DeliveryRefView.model_validate(ref) for ref in refs],
        )

    async def get_thread(
        self,
        rctx: RequestContext,
        org_id: UUID,
        delivery_id: UUID,
        secret: str,
        cursor: str | None,
        limit: int,
    ) -> MessagePageView:
        after = decode_cursor("thread", cursor) if cursor else None
        page = await self._reports.get_thread(
            rctx, org_id, delivery_id, secret, after, clamp_limit(limit)
        )
        return message_page_view("thread", page)

    async def send_follow_up(
        self,
        rctx: RequestContext,
        org_id: UUID,
        delivery_id: UUID,
        message_id: UUID,
        secret: str,
        body: AddMessageRequest,
    ) -> MessageView:
        message = await self._reports.send_follow_up(
            rctx, org_id, delivery_id, secret, a_message(message_id, delivery_id, body)
        )
        return MessageView.model_validate(message)

    async def get_deliveries(
        self,
        ctx: TenantContext,
        state: DeliveryState | None,
        tag: str | None,
        cursor: str | None,
        limit: int,
    ) -> DeliveryPageView:
        after = decode_cursor("inbox", cursor) if cursor else None
        page = await self._reports.get_deliveries(ctx, state, tag, after, clamp_limit(limit))
        return DeliveryPageView(
            items=[delivery_view(d) for d in page.items],
            next_cursor=encode_cursor("inbox", page.items[-1].id) if page.has_more else None,
        )

    async def get_delivery(self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID) -> DeliveryView:
        return delivery_view(await self._reports.get_delivery(ctx, delivery_id))

    async def update_delivery(
        self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID, body: UpdateDeliveryRequest
    ) -> DeliveryView:
        current = await self._reports.get_delivery(ctx, delivery_id)
        changed = Delivery.model_validate(
            {**current.model_dump(), **body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)}
        )
        return delivery_view(await self._reports.update_delivery(ctx, changed))

    async def get_report(self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID) -> SealedReportResponse:
        return SealedReportResponse(await self._reports.get_report(ctx, delivery_id))

    async def get_messages(
        self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID, cursor: str | None, limit: int
    ) -> MessagePageView:
        after = decode_cursor("messages", cursor) if cursor else None
        page = await self._reports.get_messages(ctx, delivery_id, after, clamp_limit(limit))
        return message_page_view("messages", page)

    async def create_message(
        self, ctx: TenantContext, delivery_id: UUID, body: AddMessageRequest, message_id: UUID
    ) -> MessageView:
        message = await self._reports.create_message(
            ctx, delivery_id, a_message(message_id, delivery_id, body)
        )
        return MessageView.model_validate(message)

    rctx: Rctx, reports: ReportsService, report_id: UUID, body: SendReportRequest
) -> SentReportView:
    """Send a report sealed on the device to the journalists it names. The id
    is a UUID v7 the device minted; sending again answers the same
    deliveries."""
    return await reports.send_report(rctx, report_id, body)

    "/threads/{org_id}/{delivery_id}/messages",
    response_model=MessagePageView,
    dependencies=[rate_limited("visitor")],
)
async def get_thread(
    rctx: Rctx,
    reports: ReportsService,
    org_id: UUID,
    delivery_id: UUID,
    secret: FollowUpSecret,
    cursor: str | None = None,
    limit: int = LIMIT_DEFAULT,
) -> MessagePageView:
    """The thread of one delivery, oldest first, as the source's secret
    reaches it. A wrong secret is answered as a thread that does not exist."""
    return await reports.get_thread(rctx, org_id, delivery_id, secret, cursor, limit)

4	every hosted one when none is named. That is the first form of a split: the
5	same image, told by `FREE_JOURNALISM_NAMESPACES` which routers to mount, serves one
6	namespace as a service of its own, and no code changes."""
7	
8	from collections.abc import Sequence

13	from free_journalism.services.api.routers import (
14	    admin,

17	    journalists,
18	    media,
19	    support,
20	    tenancy,
21	)
22	
23	HOSTED: dict[str, tuple[APIRouter, ...]] = {
24	    # The operator plane is tenancy's: it lists and deletes orgs.
25	    "tenancy": (tenancy.router, admin.router),
26	    # The realtime channel is the events stream pushed; its replay is `/events`.
27	    "events": (events.router, socket.router),
28	    "media": (media.router,),
29	    "journalists": (journalists.router, journalists.desks_router),
30	    "community": (community.router,),
31	    "support": (support.router,),
32	}
33	"""Every namespace this image hosts, and the routers that serve it."""
34	
35	
36	def all_routers(namespaces: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[APIRouter]:
37	    """The routers to mount; a name this image does not host refuses the boot."""
38	    unknown = sorted(set(namespaces) - set(HOSTED))
39	    if unknown:
40	        raise ValueError(
41	            f"FREE_JOURNALISM_NAMESPACES names {', '.join(unknown)}; this image hosts {', '.join(HOSTED)}"
42	        )
43	    chosen = namespaces or tuple(HOSTED)
44	    return [router for name in HOSTED if name in chosen for router in HOSTED[name]]

import base64
import hashlib
import logging
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID, uuid4, uuid7

import httpx
import pytest
from api_support import add_member, sign_in_as, sign_in_personal

from free_journalism.om.context import Role
from free_journalism.om.reports.rules import MAX_REPORT_BYTES
from free_journalism.services.api.container import AppContainer

SEALED = b"\x00a sealed report\xff"
SECRET = "a-follow-up-secret-the-device-made-0123456789"
JOURNALIST_KEY = base64.b64encode(b"j" * 32).decode()
SOURCE_KEY = base64.b64encode(b"s" * 32).decode()


def b64(data: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.b64encode(data).decode()


async def a_desk(client: httpx.AsyncClient, email: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str, str]:
    """A journalist's own desk with one profile that takes reports: the
    desk's headers, its org id, and the journalist's id."""
    desk = await sign_in_personal(client, email)
    org_id = (await client.get("/v1/orgs/current", headers=desk)).json()["id"]
    added = await client.post(
        "/v1/journalists",
        headers={**desk, "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid4())},
        json={"display_name": "Ada Reporter", "public_key": JOURNALIST_KEY},
    )
    assert added.status_code == 201, added.text
    return desk, org_id, added.json()["id"]


def a_report(
    *recipients: tuple[str, str], ciphertext: bytes = SEALED, replies: bool = True
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body: dict[str, Any] = {
        "ciphertext": b64(ciphertext),
        "recipients": [
            {"org_id": org_id, "journalist_id": journalist_id, "wrapped_key": b64(bytes([n]) * 92)}
            for n, (org_id, journalist_id) in enumerate(recipients)
        ],
    }
    if replies:
        body["source_public_key"] = SOURCE_KEY
        body["follow_up_digest"] = hashlib.sha256(SECRET.encode()).hexdigest()
    return body


async def send(client: httpx.AsyncClient, report_id: UUID, body: dict[str, Any]) -> httpx.Response:
    return await client.put(f"/v1/reports/{report_id}", json=body)


async def one_delivery(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, email: str = "ada@example.test", *, replies: bool = True
) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str, str]:
    """A report sent to one desk: the desk's headers, its org, the delivery."""
    desk, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, email)
    sent = await send(client, uuid7(), a_report((org_id, journalist_id), replies=replies))
    assert sent.status_code == 200, sent.text
    return desk, org_id, sent.json()["deliveries"][0]["delivery_id"]


async def test_a_source_sends_to_two_desks_and_each_opens_its_own_copy(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
) -> None:
    desk_a, org_a, ada = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    desk_b, org_b, bea = await a_desk(client, "bea@example.test")
    report_id = uuid7()
    sent = await send(client, report_id, a_report((org_a, ada), (org_b, bea)))
    assert sent.status_code == 200, sent.text
    view = sent.json()
    assert view["report_id"] == str(report_id)
    assert [(d["org_id"], d["journalist_id"]) for d in view["deliveries"]] == [
        (org_a, ada),
        (org_b, bea),
    ]
    for n, (desk, ref) in enumerate(zip((desk_a, desk_b), view["deliveries"], strict=True)):
        inbox = await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk)
        assert inbox.status_code == 200, inbox.text
        (item,) = inbox.json()["items"]
        assert item["id"] == ref["delivery_id"]
        assert item["wrapped_key"] == b64(bytes([n]) * 92), "each desk its own key"
        assert item["report_digest"] == hashlib.sha256(SEALED).hexdigest()
        assert (item["report_size"], item["report_id"]) == (len(SEALED), str(report_id))
        assert (item["source_public_key"], item["has_thread"]) == (SOURCE_KEY, True)
        assert (item["state"], item["tags"]) == ("new", [])
        assert "follow_up_digest" not in item
        one = await client.get(f"/v1/inbox/{item['id']}", headers=desk)
        assert one.status_code == 200 and one.json() == item
        report = await client.get(f"/v1/inbox/{item['id']}/report", headers=desk)
        assert report.status_code == 200, report.text
        assert report.content == SEALED
        assert report.headers["content-type"] == "application/octet-stream"
        assert report.headers["cache-control"] == "no-store"
        events = (await client.get("/v1/events", headers=desk)).json()
        opened = [e for e in events if e["kind"] == "reports.delivery.opened"]
        assert [e["target_id"] for e in opened] == [item["id"]], "every open is audited"
        created = [e for e in events if e["kind"] == "reports.delivery.created"]
        assert [e["actor_id"] for e in created] == ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]


async def test_a_send_made_again_answers_the_same_deliveries(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    desk, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    report_id = uuid7()
    body = a_report((org_id, journalist_id))
    first = await send(client, report_id, body)
    again = await send(client, report_id, body)
    assert again.status_code == 200 and again.json() == first.json()
    assert len((await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk)).json()["items"]) == 1
    other = await send(client, report_id, a_report((org_id, journalist_id), ciphertext=b"else"))
    assert other.status_code == 409, other.text


async def test_a_send_is_held_to_its_bounds(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    desk, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    keyless = await client.post(
        "/v1/journalists",
        headers={**desk, "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid4())},
        json={"display_name": "No Key"},
    )
    assert (await send(client, uuid7(), a_report((org_id, keyless.json()["id"])))).status_code == 422
    assert (await send(client, uuid7(), a_report((str(uuid4()), journalist_id)))).status_code == 404
    assert (await send(client, uuid4(), a_report((org_id, journalist_id)))).status_code == 422
    half = a_report((org_id, journalist_id))
    del half["follow_up_digest"]
    assert (await send(client, uuid7(), half)).status_code == 422
    assert (await send(client, uuid7(), {**half, "recipients": []})).status_code == 422
    assert (await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk)).json()["items"] == []


async def test_a_report_as_large_as_the_bound_is_taken_and_one_byte_more_is_not(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
) -> None:
    desk, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    largest = a_report((org_id, journalist_id), ciphertext=b"\x01" * MAX_REPORT_BYTES)
    taken = await send(client, uuid7(), largest)
    assert taken.status_code == 200, taken.text[:200]
    (item,) = (await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk)).json()["items"]
    assert item["report_size"] == MAX_REPORT_BYTES
    past = a_report((org_id, journalist_id), ciphertext=b"\x01" * (MAX_REPORT_BYTES + 1))
    assert (await send(client, uuid7(), past)).status_code == 422


async def test_the_inbox_filters_pages_and_moves_a_delivery(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    desk, org_id, journalist_id = await a_desk(client, "ada@example.test")
    ids = sorted(
        [
            (await send(client, uuid7(), a_report((org_id, journalist_id)))).json()[
                "deliveries"
            ][0]["delivery_id"]
            for _ in range(3)
        ],
        key=UUID,
    )
    moved = await client.patch(
        f"/v1/inbox/{ids[0]}", headers=desk, json={"state": "follow-up", "tags": ["water"]}
    )
    assert moved.status_code == 200, moved.text
    assert (moved.json()["state"], moved.json()["tags"]) == ("follow-up", ["water"])
    tagged = await client.patch(f"/v1/inbox/{ids[2]}", headers=desk, json={"tags": ["water"]})
    assert (tagged.json()["state"], tagged.json()["tags"]) == ("new", ["water"])
    listed = await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk, params={"state": "follow-up"})
    assert [d["id"] for d in listed.json()["items"]] == [ids[0]]
    water = await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk, params={"tag": "water"})
    assert [d["id"] for d in water.json()["items"]] == [ids[0], ids[2]]
    both = await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk, params={"tag": "water", "state": "new"})
    assert [d["id"] for d in both.json()["items"]] == [ids[2]]
    first = (await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=desk, params={"limit": 2})).json()
    assert [d["id"] for d in first["items"]] == ids[:2] and first["next_cursor"]
    rest = await client.get(
        "/v1/inbox", headers=desk, params={"limit": 2, "cursor": first["next_cursor"]}
    )
    assert [d["id"] for d in rest.json()["items"]] == ids[2:]
    for refused in ({"state": None}, {"tags": None}, {"state": "closed"}, {"tags": [""]}):
        answer = await client.patch(f"/v1/inbox/{ids[1]}", headers=desk, json=refused)
        assert answer.status_code == 422, (refused, answer.text)
    stray = await client.patch(f"/v1/inbox/{ids[1]}", headers=desk, json={"report_size": 1})
    assert stray.status_code == 422, "only the state and the tags are the desk's"


async def test_another_desks_delivery_is_not_found_on_every_route(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
) -> None:
    _, _, delivery_id = await one_delivery(client)
    other = await sign_in_personal(client, "eve@example.test")
    for method, path, body in (
        ("GET", f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}", None),
        ("GET", f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}/report", None),
        ("PATCH", f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}", {"state": "archived"}),
        ("GET", f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}/messages", None),
        ("POST", f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}/messages", {"ciphertext": b64(b"hi")}),
    ):
        headers = {**other, "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid4())} if method == "POST" else other
        answer = await client.request(method, path, headers=headers, json=body)
        assert answer.status_code == 404, (method, path, answer.text)
    assert (await client.get("/v1/inbox", headers=other)).json()["items"] == []


async def test_a_viewer_reads_the_inbox_and_changes_nothing(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, container: AppContainer
) -> None:
    desk, org_id, delivery_id = await one_delivery(client)
    await add_member(container, UUID(org_id), "vic@example.test", Role.VIEWER)
    viewer = await sign_in_as(client, "vic@example.test", UUID(org_id))
    assert (await client.get(f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}", headers=viewer)).status_code == 200
    moved = await client.patch(f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}", headers=viewer, json={"state": "useful"})
    assert moved.status_code == 403, moved.text
    assert (await client.get(f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}/report", headers=viewer)).status_code == 403
    assert (await client.get(f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}", headers=desk)).json()["state"] == "new"


async def test_the_desks_routes_need_a_session(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    _, _, delivery_id = await one_delivery(client)
    for method, path in (
        ("GET", "/v1/inbox"),
        ("GET", f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}"),

        ("POST", f"/v1/inbox/{delivery_id}/messages"),

        answer = await client.request(method, path, json={})
